items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because Baptiste going to rob him, so he don’t . . .

ctx.x: See, what needs for him to go anywhere? He’s getting carpenter’s prices in the day time. If he want to play, he play at night. Or he don’t want to play, he don’t play. Because Baptiste going to rob him, so he don’t . . .
Were you encouraged to leave New Orleans at an early age?
